miamiNews.title: For the US news industry, a tough summer draws to a close with McClatchy chain's cuts
miamiNews.description: The McClatchy newspaper chain has made significant layoffs at The Miami Herald and other papers, cutting over 90 unionized journalists across 17 publications

tip.title: Date Night Idea: Swap Bucket Lists
tip.content: Ask your girlfriend to share 3 things on her bucket list you didn't know about. Listen without planning. Then share yours. This creates deeper connection in 15 minutes.
